description: This Java source file defines the class `UnknownTopicPathException`, which is a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception is thrown when a topic path is not supported within the protocol adapter component. The class includes builder methods for creating instances from message strings, JSON objects, or specific topic/path combinations, and contains metadata such as error codes and message templates.

classes.name: UnknownTopicPathException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception class indicating an unsupported or unknown topic path in the Ditto protocol adapter. It provides multiple static factory methods and a nested builder class for creating instances with detailed contextual information.
